reason: The app became very laggy after several overlapping trade UI runtimes, root overlays and polling loops were installed together. Remove duplicate render-tree wrappers and keep one actual multi-trade screen plus one low-load global exit control.

required_checks: Legacy AppPatched ManualExitOverlay suppressed without network polling
Full live/signal refresh only when exit window is opened or manually refreshed
Open-trade count and selected-trade exit remain available
JavaScript checks and Android Metro export
validation.performance_fix: Replace four JSX/render-tree wrappers and two competing exit overlays with one direct Trade screen and a lightweight root overlay. Avoid state updates when open-trade snapshots are unchanged.
validation.network_fix: The closed root EXIT badge reads history only every 15 seconds; trade-live and bot-signal are fetched only for the opened exit modal.
validation.ui_behavior: The red EXIT button and per-trade exit modal remain available, while the main Trade tab continues to show every open trade separately.

trade_safety: Mobile UI and polling performance only. No signal, score, automatic entry, automatic exit, quantity, stop-loss, cooldown, capital allocation, broker or order-placement logic changes.
